bib.title: Mulberry: Empowering MLLM with o1-like Reasoning and Reflection via Collective Monte Carlo Tree Search

question: Can multiple MLLMs jointly searching a reasoning tree produce step-by-step and reflective reasoning data that teaches an MLLM o1-like reasoning?
hypothesis: Tree search by a single MLLM gets trapped in homogeneous low-quality nodes and is slow; pooling several models in expansion and error positioning raises search success and cuts iterations.
contributions: CoMCTS: collective learning introduced into MCTS for MLLM reasoning-path search
Mulberry series of MLLMs with step-by-step reasoning and reflection

method.summary: CoMCTS runs Expansion, Simulation and Error Positioning, Backpropagation and Selection over a tree whose nodes are proposed and scored by four MLLMs. Found correct paths (plus reflective paths built from negative sibling nodes) form Mulberry-260K, used for plain SFT of four base MLLMs. No RL is used.
method.task: multimodal reasoning (math, charts, science, general VQA); tree-search data generation plus SFT

datasets.name: Mulberry-260K raw questions
datasets.size: 260K raw multimodal questions (image plus text instruction); 15K sampled for reflective reasoning training
datasets.source: 55K math (GLLaVA, GEOS, UniGeo, GeoQA Plus, Geo3K, MathVision, GeoMverse, MathV360K); 116K figure understanding (DVQA, DocVQA, FigureQA, PlotQA, ChartQA, InfoVQA, MultiHiertt, LRV-Chart); 41K math word problems (IconQA, TabMWP, CLEVR, CLEVR-Math, Super-CLEVR); 2K medical (VQA-RAD, PMC-VQA); 17K science (TQA, AI2D, ScienceQA); 24K natural world QA (VQA-AS, A-OKVQA, TextVQA, Vizwiz, VQA2.0)
datasets.preprocessing: questions with a found correct path are kept with the tree; final count of questions with found paths not stated

datasets.name: Geo3K + GeoQA-Plus subset
datasets.source: Lu et al. 2021a; Chen et al. 2021

datasets.name: MathVista, MMStar, MMMU, ChartQA, DynaMath, HallBench, MM-Math, MME(sum)

training.objective: SFT: maximise log pi(Y|Q) on effective paths (Eq 9) plus log pi(Y_reflect|Q) on reflective paths (Eq 10)

other.reflection_data: 15K reflective samples; reflection prompt e.g. 'The previous reasoning step is wrong and let's rethink it again.'
other.algorithm: Algorithm 1 alternates search and training over MaxEpoch

inference.prompting: Mulberry output format: Image Description, Rationales, 'Let's think step by step', Step 1..n, final answer (Fig 5)

parameters.candidates_per_iteration: one subsequent candidate path per model
